searchText: hey i am looking to hack on rust EVM client (hello Reth). Mostly want to experiment with a few consensus/p2p optimization. Looking for a client that is modular where I work below the EVM in a silo. I don't want to take the COSMOS sdk route , just like that. Any recommendations for rust ETH clients ? Hi all! I am a junior engineer at OP Labs and open source contributor to foundry and Huff language. Looking forward to the discussions and learning in here 🙂 Hey everyone! I’m andreas (aka refcell), protocol engineer @ OP Labs and also worked on Huff Lang with vex. Really excited to learn and contribute here 🚀
